name: Fail-Operational Passive Pressure-Regulating Shunt
mechanism: Single-lumen shunt with passive spring-loaded variable orifice that maintains drainage across wide ICP range
buyer_problem: Existing shunts are single-setting. Patient needs change with posture/sleep/exercise. Fixed setting causes over/under-drainage.
evidence_label: MODELLED — passive valve response curve (Poiseuille + spring mechanics)
